title: PS5 just hit a number nobody expected #ps5 #shorts
description: Sony said the PS5 is around 100 million consoles, and Sensor Tower estimated about 75% of early GTA 6 sales were on PlayStation (estimate). Sources: ARY News, PlayDay, Sensor Tower via esports.gg.

scenes.say: The PS5 is closing in on one hundred million consoles.

scenes.label: PS5 consoles
scenes.say: Sony says the PS5 is right around one hundred million units.

scenes.label: GTA 6 on PlayStation
scenes.say: And about seventy five percent of early GTA 6 copies were on PlayStation, by one estimate.
Launching the biggest game ever on your console doesn't hurt.
So which one do you play GTA 6 on?
